name: session-resume
description: Picks the session back up with "continue" when a rate-limit window resets after a limit stopped your turn

message.title: Resume message
message.description: The prompt sent when the limit resets.

bufferSeconds.title: Wait after reset
bufferSeconds.description: Seconds to wait past the reset time before resuming.

maxWaitHours.title: Longest wait
maxWaitHours.description: Windows that reset later than this (a weekly limit, say) are not waited for.
